newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla fed cattle limited test at $67 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla fed cattle limited test at $67 - USDA.

text.p: Trade slow in the panhandle area Friday, USDA said. Limited test slaughter steers and heifers $1.00 lower. Feedlots reporting moderate inquiry from buyers. Sales reported on 1,000 slaughter steers and 1,700 heifers after a weekly movement of 79,900.
Note - all cattle prices based on net weights FOB the feedlot after a 4 percent shrink.
Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1100-1250 lbs 67.00.
Slaughter Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1000-1150 lbs 67.00.
